name: FITSverify
summary: Official FITS conformance checker for FITS Standard 3.0. This is the proper tool for deep FITS validation, unlike a signature check.
license: Obtain from the official HEASARC distribution; review the included source and CFITSIO terms.

name: CFITSIO
summary: C library for FITS I/O; foundational to FITS readers, writers and validation tooling.
license: Review the license included in the current release package.

name: NASA PDS Validate
summary: Official validator for PDS4 product labels/data and PDS3 volumes. Open-source repository includes a license file.
license: Apache-2.0 (check the repository license and version).

name: NAIF SPICE Toolkit
summary: Official toolkit for reading and querying SPICE kernels (.bsp, .bc, .bpc, .tf, .ti, .tls, .tsc, .tm, .dsk and more).
license: Read the NAIF Toolkit license and support rules before redistribution.
run: Use brief SPICE utilities or language bindings for kernel checks.

name: NASA CDF library / tools
summary: Official CDF software for inspecting Common Data Format files.
license: Review license terms with the current package.
run: Use CDF tools for variable, attribute and record checks.

name: NetCDF utilities
summary: NetCDF libraries and command-line utilities for scientific array data.
license: Check the repository's current license and dependency notices.

name: HDFView / HDF5 utilities
summary: Inspect HDF5 groups, arrays and metadata; HDF4 needs separate support.
license: Review each current package's license and dependencies.

name: GDAL / OGR
summary: Open-source geospatial toolkit for GeoTIFF, COG, JP2 where drivers are built, VRT, GeoPackage, Shapefile and many raster/vector sources.
license: MIT-style/X license; verify the version and linked driver dependencies.

name: ecCodes
summary: ECMWF library and tools to decode and inspect GRIB messages.
license: Check the repository license and third-party notices.

name: Apache Parquet / Arrow
summary: Columnar file and memory formats useful for derived scientific tables and high-performance analysis.
run: Use PyArrow/DuckDB schema and metadata readers.

name: Zarr
summary: Specification and libraries for chunked N-dimensional arrays in directory/object-store datasets.
license: Check repository license and Zarr version.
run: Validate metadata and expected chunk references.

name: QGIS
summary: Desktop GIS for inspecting geospatial science products and metadata.
license: GPL; do not copy components into a different product without satisfying the applicable license.
run: Open the data in QGIS; inspect CRS and geometry validity.

name: ISIS (USGS Astrogeology)
summary: Planetary image-processing system for supported mission image cubes.
license: Review the repository's current license and bundled dependency terms.
run: Use ISIS cube and label inspection tools.

name: EUMDAC
summary: Official EUMETSAT data access client for searching and downloading products using supported authentication.
run: Install and configure according to official docs; do not store user credentials in public code.

name: Copernicus Data Space API clients
summary: Official documentation for CDSE APIs including STAC, OData and download services.
license: Client library licenses vary; review before reuse.
run: Use STAC search or the provider's documented download API.

name: NASA Earthdata CMR
summary: Publicly documented Common Metadata Repository API for collection and granule discovery; selected download links may require Earthdata Login.
license: API is a service; repository licenses apply to each client separately.
